Name: FilterInitialize
Content:
<![CDATA[
declare @$primeAlias varchar(32), @$primeJoin varchar(4000), @$primeFilter nvarchar(4000), @$detailPartition varchar(4000), @$detailAlias varchar(4000), @$detailFilter nvarchar(4000)
create table #_f(i int identity(1, 1), datasource varchar(32), type tinyint, filterkey nvarchar(4000), alias varchar(32), xtype tinyint, refKey varchar(128), exRefKey varchar(128), refdatasource varchar(32), refalias varchar(32), fieldKey varchar(128), joinClause varchar(512))
select @$primeAlias = '', @$primeJoin = '', @$primeFilter = '', @$detailPartition = '', @$detailAlias = '', @$detailFilter = ''

if object_id('tempdb..#filter') is not null begin
  insert into #_f(datasource, type, filterkey, xtype, refKey, exRefKey, refdatasource, fieldKey, joinClause)
	select isnull(b.xtable, ''), '1', replace(case when b.conditionalreplace is null then a.conditional else replace(a.conditional, char(255) + a.field, replace(replace(b.conditionalreplace, b.name, a.field), '%2', '%l')) end, char(255) + a.field, case when charindex(char(254), isnull(b.exname, '')) > 0 then '' else '%[a].' end + isnull(replace(replace(b.exname, '%2', '%l'), char(254), ''), a.field)), case when b.conditionalreplace is null then a.type else 0 end, b.fieldkey, b.exfieldkey, b.reftable, b.reffieldkey, isnull(b.joinclause, '')
      from #filter a join @@sysDatabaseName..sysfilterdeclares b on b.controller = ]]>&Controller;<![CDATA[ and a.field = replace(b.name, '%2', '%l')
end

if exists(select 1 from #_f) exec FastBusiness$System$GetDynamicFilter @@userID, @@admin, @$primeAlias output, @$primeJoin output, @$primeFilter output, @$detailPartition output, @$detailAlias output, @$detailFilter output
]]>

Name: FlowMultiUpdateCurrentStock
Content:
select top 0 cast(0 as int) as id, sl_nhap as ton13 into #ton from wrkin
declare @$stock$View$Type char(1)
if '' = '2' and exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_instock_split' and val = '1')
  select @$stock$View$Type = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_instock_view2'
else 
  select @$stock$View$Type = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_instock_view'

select @$stock$View$Type = isnull(@$stock$View$Type, '1')

if not exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_instock_onhand' and val = '1') begin
  set @q = 'insert into #ton select a.id, e.ton13 / case when a.he_so <> 0 then a.he_so else 1 end as ton13 from #d a'
  set @q = @q + case 
    when @$stock$View$Type = '1' then ' left join cdvt13 e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho'
    when @$stock$View$Type = '2' then ' left join cdvitri13 e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = e.ma_vi_tri'
    when @$stock$View$Type = '3' then ' left join cdklo13 e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = e.ma_lo'
    when @$stock$View$Type = '4' then ' left join cdlo13 e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = e.ma_lo and a.ma_vi_tri = e.ma_vi_tri'
    else '' end
  exec sp_executesql @q
  
  update #d set ton13 = b.ton13 from #d a join #ton b on a.id = b.id
end else begin
  select top 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong as ton13 into #xcd from cdvt73
  select top 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo into #dton from #d

  if @$stock$View$Type = '1' insert into #dton select distinct ma_kho, '', ma_vt, '' from #d
  else if @$stock$View$Type = '2' insert into #dton select distinct ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, '' from #d
  else if @$stock$View$Type = '3' insert into #dton select distinct ma_kho, '', ma_vt, ma_lo from #d
  else if @$stock$View$Type = '4' insert into #dton select distinct ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo from #d

  if @$stock$View$Type = '1' begin
    insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, '', a.ma_vt, '', sum(ton13) from #dton d join cdvt13 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt
	  if '' = ''
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, '', a.ma_vt, '', sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt73 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt
	  else
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, '', a.ma_vt, '', sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt93 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt
    
    update #d set ton13 = e.ton13 from #d a left join (select ma_kho, ma_vt, sum(ton13) as ton13 from #xcd group by ma_kho, ma_vt) e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho
  end
  
  if @$stock$View$Type = '2' begin
	  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, '', sum(ton13) from #dton d join cdvitri13 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt
	  if '' = ''
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, '', sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt73 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt
	  else
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, '', sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt93 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt

	  update #d set ton13 = e.ton13 from #d a left join (select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, sum(ton13) as ton13 from #xcd group by ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri) e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = e.ma_vi_tri
  end
  
  if @$stock$View$Type = '3' begin
	  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, '', a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, sum(ton13) from #dton d join cdklo13 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = d.ma_lo group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo
	  if '' = ''
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, '', a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt73 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = d.ma_lo group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo
	  else
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, '', a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt93 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = d.ma_lo group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo

	  update #d set ton13 = e.ton13 from #d a left join (select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo, sum(ton13) as ton13 from #xcd group by ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_lo) e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = e.ma_lo
  end

  if @$stock$View$Type = '4' begin
	  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, sum(ton13) from #dton d join cdlo13 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_lo = d.ma_lo group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo
	  if '' = ''
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt73 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_lo = d.ma_lo group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo
	  else
		  insert into #xcd select a.ma_kho, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_vt, a.ma_lo, sum(a.so_luong) from #dton d join cdvt93 a on a.ma_vt = d.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = d.ma_kho and a.ma_vi_tri = d.ma_vi_tri and a.ma_lo = d.ma_lo group by a.ma_kho, a.ma_vt, a.ma_vi_tri, a.ma_lo

	  update #d set ton13 = e.ton13 from #d a left join (select ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo, sum(ton13) as ton13 from #xcd group by ma_kho, ma_vt, ma_vi_tri, ma_lo) e on a.ma_vt = e.ma_vt and a.ma_kho = e.ma_kho and a.ma_lo = e.ma_lo and a.ma_vi_tri = e.ma_vi_tri
  end
end

Name: FlowMultiTagRowRequest
Content:
declare @s nvarchar(128), @l int, @size int, @i int
select top 0 identity(int, 1, 1) as id, stt_rec, cast('' as char(3)) as stt_rec0, cast('' as char(6)) as p into #tagRow from 
select @size = 0
select @i = 1, @l = datalength(text) from @k
select @size = charindex(',', text, @size) from @k

while @size > 0 begin
  select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @size - @i), '''', '') from @k
  insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s)-1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s)))
  select @i = @size + 1
  select @size = charindex(',', text, @size + 1) from @k
end
if @i < @l begin
  select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @l - @i), '''', '') from @k
  insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s)-1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s)))
end
update #tagRow set p = convert(char(6), b.ngay_ct, 112) from #tagRow a join  b on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
